rationale: Windows Defender (MsMpEng.exe / WdFilter.sys) and Windows Security Center (SecurityHealthService.exe) evolve on Microsoft's monthly Patch Tuesday and Windows 11 24H2/25H2 cumulative release cadence rather than traditional semantic API contracts. CalVer (YYYY.0M.MICRO) immediately communicates which Windows 11 cumulative update wave and Defender platform version a release targets.

releases.summary: Remove remaining em-dashes and legacy Standing Orders / Command Center wording from Windows executable metadata (winres.json), service description, CLI output, version summary, and shortcut descriptions.

Embed application icon resource (RT_GROUP_ICON) so shiesh.exe shows its icon in Task Manager and Explorer, and order presets by protection descending (Cloud + Local, Local Protection, Workstation, On-Demand Only) across UI, system tray, CLI, docs, and site.
Simplify presets (Local Protection, Workstation, On-Demand Only, Cloud + Local), replace thematic CLI verbs (apply, set, pause), move CLI docs to CLI.md, and refresh the site and preview screenshot.

Default no-arg shiesh.exe to read-only CLI status exit 0 for WinGet compatibility, make Read-Only ui window-bound without a persistent tray, require elevation for tray mode, and harden build.ps1 with lock detection and ShieldSheriff.lnk generation.
Add About modal on clickable sidebar brand, streamline systray menu with top-level presets, and align first-run unconfigured state across Auto-Heal and Settings.

Adopt native WebView2 Windows 11 Settings UI with Mica and theme sync, first-run consent, Passive Mode, logon startup, startup update check, three-state systray icons, tilted hat logo, and shiesh.exe / config.json naming.
Suppress owned terminal window on startup, show running status in system tray, shut down server and governor when tray closes, and add portable GitHub Release + winget manifest workflow.
Compact tabbed Command Center UI with inline SVG Sheriff preset cards, hover diff preview, granular overrides, and single-instance process/window locking.
Public release website, competitor comparison simulator, CalVer version metadata CLI/API, and November 2026 Defender platform verification.
Embedded dark-mode localhost Command Center UI (127.0.0.1:38419) with chromeless Edge app window launcher, live telemetry cards, and interactive preset switching.
Native Win32 system tray UI (Shell_NotifyIconW) with procedural 2x2-supersampled 32-bit ARGB 6-pointed Sheriff Star HICON renderer and quick context menus.
Native Win32 Service Control Manager (SCM) SYSTEM service dispatcher and persistent 5-second drift auto-healer against monthly Patch Tuesday policy resets.
Timed Deputy Stand-Down and Win32 CreateToolhelp32Snapshot process watcher to automatically pause Real-Time Protection during cargo, rustc, msbuild, and link builds.
Switched WMI MSFT_MpPreference synchronization to explicit DCOM CimSession Option so live engine sync succeeds on machines with WinRM/WSMan disabled, plus 0x4/0x5 Tamper Protection bitmask detection.
Added live WMI MSFT_MpPreference synchronization alongside HKLM policy locks after Defender platform 4.18.25050 stopped hot-reloading registry-only edits.

Comprehensive Windows 11 24H2 SecurityHealthService toast & tray nag suppression (DisableNotifications, DisableEnhancedNotifications, Notification_Suppress, and reversible SecurityHealthSystray backup/mute).
Initial public CLI release with native Win32 Registry inspection, UAC self-elevation, MpCmdRun on-demand scan/update wrappers, and Quiet Guardian standing orders.
